Apply Now With LuanN

NMLS ID#: 1081296

How Can I Help You?

Let’s talk, I am committed to providing financing options to homebuyers and homeowners in the Global/Rhode Island Area. Whether purchasing your first home, investing in real estate, refinancing a home, or building your dream home, I will make certain to provide you with all your financing options to help you choose the best solution for you and your family’s financing needs. 

Averon Trust Bank has a highly competitive pricing structure and state of the art technology, in-house underwriting, processing, and servicing. We are committed to guiding you through your home buying, refinancing, or new construction purchase and I look forward to talking with you. My number one goal is to make your home financing as smooth and stress-free as possible. 

A Little About Me

I have been in the mortgage business for 18 years, specializing in building strong relationships with my clients, assisting my clients with pre-qualification through closing their home.

Purchasing a home is a process and I ensure that my clients understand each step along the way.  

I enjoy helping people and volunteering. One of my favorite things to do is to cook a nice dinner for my elders who no longer navigate the kitchen. I take pleasure in listening to their stories and sharing an evening. To me, there is nothing better than appreciating the simplicity in life with my family.
